### The Coming Knowledge of God's Glory
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/coming-knowledge-of-gods-glory
Passage: Habakkuk 2:14
Points:
- Although God reveals His power and divinity through nature, an even greater revelation of His glory is promised to all people.
- Habakkuk foretells a coming day when knowledge of the Lord's glory will encompass the world as waters cover the sea.
- While foreshadowed in the judgment of Babylon and Israel's return from exile, the promise reaches ultimate fulfillment in Christ's kingdom.
- The redemption of sinners displays an aspect of God's glory as Savior that general revelation cannot show.
- The church actively participates in fulfilling this prophecy today by proclaiming the gospel and discipling the nations.

### What We Talk Like When We Talk About God
Author: Jared C. Wilson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/what-we-talk-like-when-we-talk-about-god/
Passage: Habakkuk 2:20
Points:
- Modern spiritual individualism often rejects church commitment and divine authority in favor of self-expression.
- Speaking of God without reverence reduces Him to an agreeable personal concept rather than the holy Sovereign of Scripture.
- Habakkuk 2:20 summons all creation into awe-filled silence before the reigning Lord in His holy sanctuary.
- Gathering with God's people counters autonomy by quieting our own voices to hear His authoritative word.
- Cultivating reverent trembling before God's holy righteousness opens the way to genuine joy in the saving work of Christ.
